1–2 days before the trip, over Wi-Fi. The plan usually starts when it connects to a network at your destination.
Can I buy in advance? When does the plan start?

Yes. The plan starts not on the purchase date, but when the eSIM first connects to a network in your destination. E.g. buy today, fly in 3 days — your 7 days start only there. Just start using it, usually within 30 days.
Can I reuse the QR code?
No, the QR works only once. Don't delete the eSIM from your phone.
Do I get a phone number?
Most plans are data-only. You can call via Telegram, WhatsApp, etc.
It doesn't work — what do I do?
Check that Data Roaming is on and the eSIM is selected for mobile data. Otherwise tap “Contact support”.

app.doc_terms:
Booking eSIM is a service selling travel eSIMs via Telegram. eSIMs run on the networks of partner providers and local operators.

Before buying, make sure your phone supports eSIM and is not carrier-locked (Help → My phone).

The plan starts when the eSIM first connects to a network in your destination. You usually need to start using it within 30 days.

The QR code can be installed only once — do not delete the eSIM from your phone.

Speed and coverage depend on the local operator. On daily plans, speed is reduced after the daily limit.

By using the service you agree to these terms.
app.doc_privacy:
We store only the data needed to provide the service: Telegram ID, name and username, chosen language, orders, payment receipts and support chat messages.

eSIMs are issued in our name — your personal data is not shared with or sold to third parties.

We do not store your card details: payments go through your bank, Click, Payme or Telegram.

To delete your data, write to the support chat.
app.doc_refund:
If the eSIM is not delivered or does not work for a technical reason and we cannot fix it, you get a full refund.

If you cancel a paid order before the eSIM is sent, you get a refund.

If the eSIM has been installed or used, it is non-refundable: an eSIM is a one-time digital product.

If the eSIM could not be installed because your phone does not support it, each case is reviewed individually.

To request a refund, send your order number to the support chat. Refunds go back to the original payment method within 1–10 business days.

iphone: Open this PDF on your iPhone and tap the "iPhone" button under the QR (iOS 17.4 or newer). The phone opens the "Add eSIM" screen — tap "Continue".
Settings > Cellular > Add eSIM > Use QR Code. Scan the QR code from another screen.
Settings > Cellular > Add eSIM > Use QR Code > Enter Details Manually. Enter the SM-DP+ address and the "Activation code (iPhone)".
Settings > Cellular > new eSIM: turn on "Turn On This Line" and "Data Roaming". Select this eSIM under "Cellular Data".
android: Open this PDF on your Android phone and tap the "Android" button under the QR. The phone opens the eSIM setup screen — confirm.
Settings > Connections > SIM manager > Add eSIM > "Scan QR code" or "Enter activation code" (enter the "Activation code (Android)").
Settings > Network & internet > SIMs > Add SIM > Download an eSIM > scan the QR code.
Settings > SIM cards & mobile networks > Add eSIM (names differ slightly by model).
SIM manager > turn on the new eSIM > Mobile networks > turn on "Data roaming". Select this eSIM for mobile data.
